news.title: Kraken's parent company Payward alleges $25 million crypto custody fraud in lawsuit against Etana and firm's CEO
news.summary: The crypto exchange claims client funds were misused, commingled and concealed in a “Ponzi-like” scheme that unraveled amid a liquidity crisis.

news.title: Binance is launching a withdrawal lock to help deter crypto wrench attacks
news.summary: The lock is meant to protect users from being forced into withdrawing their funds, though it's an internal policy and not a cryptographic lock.
